tried: The report PDF (Dropbox link on the report page, opened inline in the built-in browser; 68 pages, 13.4 MB): the text layer is glyph-encoded (custom font encoding), so pdf.js text extraction returns unreadable codes on every page except a copyright line; 'preventable' cannot be searched. The definition of preventable drowning was therefore not read. A person can find it by eye in the PDF; do not try text extraction.

watersafetynz.org/drowning-insights and /drowning-insights/drownbase-and-data-science: neither page defines 'preventable drowning'; the DrownBase page says drowning information is entered from the Police and the Coroners Court and that a 2025 audit reconciled DrownBase with the National Coronial Information System.

The counts were read instead from the report's web edition: each environment and activity section embeds an Infogram chart whose page carries its data table (window.infographicData), which gives one row per year 2015–2025 with 'Fatalities' and '10 yr average'. All 13 charts were read the same way.
notes: WHAT WAS READ: the data tables behind all thirteen charts of the report's web edition (seven environments, six activities), each a 2015–2025 series with a ten-year average. 2025, as printed: Coast 29, Tidal 14, Rivers 17, Offshore 3, Inland still 9, Pools 3, Home 3; Swimming 15, Craft 17, Fishing from land 10, Underwater 6, Slips and falls 24, Other recreation 6. The four values already in the ledger from the visible text (tidal 14, rivers 17, offshore 3, inland still 9; swimming 15, craft 17, fishing 10, slips 24) match the chart data exactly, which is the check that the tables belong to the same report. 2024 values in the same tables: Coast 27, Tidal 17, Rivers 14, Offshore 9, Inland still 3, Pools 1, Home 3; Swimming 18, Craft 20, Fishing from land 7, Underwater 4, Slips and falls 20, Other recreation 5. Ten-year averages: 32, 13.7, 19.1, 3.8, 7, 5.6, 4.8; 18.3, 16.3, 6.2, 8.3, 30.5, 5.9. The lab does not add them; the reader may notice the seven environment values do not reach 78 and the six activity values do not either, which the report does not explain on the web edition. WHY PARTIAL: the definition of preventable drowning was not read (PDF text layer unreadable by machine; see tried). The corrections fill the four placeholder rows (figure, low, high, grade, scope, do_not_add_to, note) and fix the coast-men scope; the shared do_not_add_to text on the other setting rows still says the Pools, Home and all-sex Coast counts were not read and should be trimmed by the reviewer (not proposed here to stay under the corrections limit). Grade A because the figures are the publisher's own data tables in its own edition of the report. No names recorded.
